items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: Incidentally, there should have been a chapter on Bessie Smith, too, which John Hammond had promised to write.

ctx.x: He must have had a band that day. I wonder who's undrawn.

Yeah, I don't know. Anyway, I started to laugh about that. So naturally, we weren't putting him in the New Orleans chapter, but he deserved to be in the book and all, too. I mean, a lot of people left out of the book. It just happened to be an anthology that they took a few people and tried to get them to write about their favorites. Incidentally, there should have been a chapter on Bessie Smith, too, which John Hammond had promised to write.
